title: Spec
description: A design for one feature or change: titled sections, the decisions it makes and the questions it leaves open.

section.description: A titled piece of the spec. The body holds its text.

decision.description: A question the spec settles. The title states it, chosen says what was picked, status says whether it is proposed or decided, and the body gives the reasoning.

open-question.description: A question the spec leaves open. The body says what is known so far.
